verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing ships client SDKs (the iOS and Authentication SDKs) and a hosted platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack, however, documents no telemetry controls, analytics opt-out, or usage-tracking settings. The cited items cover card issuing, authorisation, disputes, 3D Secure and webhooks only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
